processing: Fresh shoots are spread out, lightly withered, fixed at high heat, rubbed into strips, cooled and dried.
harvest_season: Around Qingming, one bud with one leaf or one bud with two just-opening leaves.
appearance_dry: Plump, somewhat flattened strips of yellow-green with silvery down over the whole leaf.
appearance_wet: Green shading into yellow, soft and tender.
taste_profile: A fresh, clearly floral aroma over a mellow, gently sweet body with a returning sweetness in the finish.

brewing.notes: As with other downy spring greens, a glass or a low-sided cup and water well off the boil work best. Some haze from the down is normal.

vintage_note: As is usual for Zhejiang green teas, it is sold as the current spring harvest and is best drunk within the year. Lots picked around Qingming are the ones to ask for.
description:
Lanxi Maofeng is a downy green tea from Lanxi in central Zhejiang, grown around Xiachen, Xinzhai and Panshan. It is easy to confuse with the far better known Huangshan Maofeng from Anhui, since maofeng describes a style of hairy tips, not one place.

The tell is in the leaf: yellow-green strips covered in silver down. Shoots are spread out and lightly withered before they meet the heat, then rolled, cooled and dried.

In the cup it is described as green and clear, floral on the nose and mellow in the mouth, with sweetness that comes back after you swallow. Treat it like other tender spring greens: cooler water, no long stew in a hot pot.

Look for the harvest date and a clear statement of Lanxi origin, because the word maofeng on its own tells you little.
history:
Little reliable documentation is easy to reach. A Chinese consumer reference claims more than three hundred years of production and says the tea is included in the book Zhongguo Mingcha, but gives no primary record behind the age, so it is best treated as a local claim.

It does turn up in Chinese lists of provincial origin teas, where Lanxi is named for its maofeng, and alongside Huangshan Maofeng as one of the known teas of this style.
